Unstick gets stuck parts of macOS working again. It restarts the Dock after your Mac wakes or unlocks, to clear the macOS 27 glitches where clicking an app in the Dock opens the wrong app, the Dock and menu bar stay over full-screen apps, and swipes between Spaces stop working.

- Press **Control-Option-Command-D** to restart the Dock any time.
- Press **Control-Option-Command-F** to restart Finder when it stops responding.

Unstick was called macos-dockwake before version 1.1. If you have macos-dockwake, Unstick copies its settings, quits it, and offers to move it to the Trash.

## Install

1. Download **Unstick-…dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Unstick** onto the **Applications** folder.
3. Open Unstick from your Applications folder.
4. macOS says it can't check the app for malicious software, because the app isn't signed with a paid Apple developer account. Click **Done**.
5. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down to the message about Unstick, and click **Open Anyway**. Enter your password if asked.
6. Choose **Start at Login** in the welcome message.

Its icon then appears in the menu bar. You only need to approve it once.

The zip contains the same app, for people who prefer it to a disk image.

Requires macOS 13 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel.
